Entity collision: 'David Geha' on the open web resolves to a TV producer; zero corroboration of the AI-consultant entity
Toxic inherited backlink profile: 57 referring domains, 50 sampled are a PBN/casino package (backlink score 11/100) — disavow prepared
Page-type mismatch: 205-word portfolio landing vs SERPs dominated by directories and 650-2,500-word priced service pages
No Google Business Profile, no phone, zero citations (Local SEO 16/100)
Live FAQPage schema has no visible FAQ (policy violation; fixed in working tree)

findings.title: Toxic PBN/casino/pharma link package (57 referring domains)
findings.description: Moz (cached 2026-09-19T16:06Z, confidence 0.85): DA 9, PA 27, spam score 4, 57 linking root domains, avg referring-domain spam score 8.4, 32% of sampled domains at high-risk spam >=10. Mechanical 2x/4x link pattern, casino/pharma/fake-news category mix, apparently built within ~4 months of the 2026-02-10 domain registration. Confidence-weighted 7-factor score (4/7 factors scored): 11/100.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with owner these were not knowingly purchased, check GSC Security & Manual Actions, then upload disavow-draft.txt (50 of 57 domains ready) to https://search.google.com/search-console/disavow-links.

findings.title: Moz API quota exhausted mid-audit — competitor gap analysis incomplete
findings.description: All Moz metrics/domains calls for 7 named competitors (and a fresh own-domain re-check) returned 403 access denied this session, despite Tier 2 being confirmed active. Likely free-tier monthly quota exhausted by the earlier same-day pull.
findings.recommendation: Retry Moz domains for competitors once quota resets, or install the DataForSEO extension for reliable competitor referring-domain data to complete the shared-referring-domain gap table.
